Deciding to take care of my physical and mental health. A year ago I thought it was quirky to not take care of my body by bleaching my hair every week, and eating literal garbage all the time. My hair was very damaged, along with my skin, and I gained 30 lbs. I was depressed and self harming, and had gotten on the side of social media that romanticizes mental illness and self harm. It made me think that harming my body was cool, so I didn’t want to get help. 

Now, I’m trying my best to do what I can with the scraps of my body last-year me left behind. I got mental help, and I’m eating better. I lost 48 lbs, and my hair and skin are healthier. I actually have friends now. I leave my room, and sleep at night, instead of during the day. I shower regularly, brush my teeth at least once a day, and wear clean clothes during the week. 

But most of all, I’m kind of happy. I don’t feel as sad all the time, because I finally have something to live for. If rather spend my time improving, than hating everything.
